selection.objective: Expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar
selection.selected_uncertainty: Whether RM4404 offers reproducible useful corneal function with an interpretable article/exposure and a bounded product contribution, rather than a sensory-surrogate or major sterile-product project
selection.basis: Next eligible public-source sprint after APR closure, following independent conditional development order APR1/RM2/BLU3 and testing fresh evidence that could reverse the selection

decision: Complete the selected RM4404 public-source sprint; retain conditional independent qualification and the review's APR1/RM2/BLU3 development ordering. No full program, new allocation or spending commitment.
scientific_tier: existing independent-validation priority; no S-tier promotion

independent_review.read_scope: Ten-page review recovered in Round16; RM-specific objective, rank, scope and budget passages rechecked in this sprint

intended_claim: Useful recovery or sustained control of injury-related corneal hypoesthesia, with tissue integrity/clarity and symptom burden appropriate to the selected clinical use

tranche_assumption.status: analyst assumption, not a verified budget or timeline

completed_evidence_gains.finding: Model-specific source audit preserves direct delayed chemical-injury structural contrasts instead of generalizing the weak late surgical contrast to all RM evidence.
Early-versus-delayed chemical-injury comparison differs in time since last dose; finite-course follow-up and treatment-timing inference remain separate.
Thickness evidence uses readings nested within sections and three mice/group; large figure N values and inconsistent statistical labels do not establish large independent-animal support.

The 2025 institutional abstract provides preliminary direct sensory contrasts, but different analysis descriptions and unlinked observations prevent importing its p-values into the final paper or counting independent replication.

Exact article and carrier evidence remain formulation-specific; nominal composition, morphology, analogous-carrier tolerance and research catalogs do not validate transferred content, release, exposure or ocular safety.

A longer cenegermin extension is observational, permits additional care, defines responder-specific endpoints and prespecifies observed-case analyses. An active Phase3 epithelial-healing program is competition, not a sensory result.

routes.name: Defined existing-article qualification plus one appropriate existing injury/function route
routes.question: Can an interpretable article support useful sensory recovery with coherent tissue condition and acceptable local exposure?

routes.name: Product contribution for a specified clinical population
routes.question: Does the product add useful benefit, burden/tolerability improvement or another credible contribution versus appropriate care in post-injury hypoesthesia or a separately defined NK/PCED population?

routes.name: Major formulation, model or rights development
routes.question: Does the revised opportunity still exceed alternatives after the added cost, time and capture burden?

branches.condition: Article, matched control and an appropriate existing model can yield an informative useful-function decision at genuinely small scope
branches.decision: Retain RM as a conditional qualification opportunity at the independent review's second development position

branches.condition: Only a blink-threshold change survives, without evidence adequate to the intended patient benefit or with pain/ocular harm
branches.decision: Do not promote the repair product on the surrogate; narrow the claim or stop the corresponding route

branches.condition: Salt, solvent, article degradation or exposure makes the result uninterpretable
branches.decision: Resolve the consequential transfer ambiguity within the bounded scope; do not call target failure from an unqualified article

branches.condition: Sterile product, new model or rights work materially exceeds the assumed small tranche
branches.decision: Recompare actual remaining cost/time/information/capture against BLU, other eligible opportunities and waiting before extending scope

branches.condition: Scientific benefit remains but incremental clinical contribution or retained financial value is inadequate
branches.decision: Defer or redirect asset development; separately justify evidence/public-benefit work

decision_inputs_remaining: Exact reproducible article and matched vehicle
Independent useful function with appropriate biological units and masking
Specific target population, comparator and clinical contribution
Applicable rights, access terms and retained economics
Actual cost/time of the next finite deliverable

reopen_only_for: Accessible substantive transparency/raw-observation document or primary correction
Independent exact-article functional result with relevant units and comparator
New exact-product stability, release, exposure or ocular-tolerance data
Substantive current comparator result or identifiable published claim record
Defined product/access/transaction facts changing a specific next commitment
